description: Copy an image into the GravityPort library and save prompt recipe metadata. The image path must be an absolute path on this machine. Symbolic links are rejected. Only supported image and video formats are imported. Identical bytes already in the library (outside Trash) return the existing asset with deduplicated: true instead of creating a copy.

business_fields.description: Stored with the asset but not searchable; put anything that should be findable via search into tags instead.

category.description: Category label shown in the app.

favorite.description: Mark the asset as a favorite.

group.description: Group the asset is filed under; grouping, not a project.

imagePath.description: Absolute path of the image on this machine.

allowed_uses.description: Purposes this reference may serve, for example identity, style, world, wardrobe, composition. Once set, any purpose outside the list is treated as forbidden.

forbidden_uses.description: Purposes this reference must not serve. A forbidden use always overrides the same allowed use.

rights.description: Rights declarations for the reference image. Unstated fields stay unknown; silence is never recorded as permission.

source.description: Optional generation provenance, such as generation_tool, model, codex_session_id, or codex_thread_id. The original image path and Codex task ID are detected automatically.

sourceType.description: Optional source type. Defaults to codex-generated for images under <CODEX_HOME>/generated_images (normally the user's .codex/generated_images), and to mcp-agent (an image saved by an AI assistant, shown as "AI 助手" in the App) for everything else.

tags.description: Tags saved with the asset; searchable.

user_prompt.description: Optional user request kept separately from the effective generation prompt.

name: asset_create
